definition: Fixed feature z=(measured represented state-archived mean)/(archived std+epsilon); maxima include finite outliers. No updates. Threshold 100 only inventories magnitude.
scope: All registered non-repeat branches, candidate predictor never supplied. Valid complete first failure included. State after the terminal interval can be a target but is excluded from all later legal input windows.
source_indices: response [20ms transition index, branch]; online [transition, lane]; old long/teacher [local transition]
physical_validation: Hinge and finger coordinate and velocity blocks compared elementwise (zero tolerance) to original recorded qpos[:,7:31] and qvel[:,6:30] for complete response successors plus first online inputs. Full-state 63 fields also checked for all response successors.

stats_lineage.held1: contact_s0_wm_held_r1 initialized from B0-03 compatible layers; fit_contact_model.py updates normalization from valid training inputs only
stats_lineage.held2: contact_s0_wm_held_r2 resume of held_r1 u200 through 2000
stats_lineage.lanes: lanes_wm_v1 initialized at held_r2 2000, fixed_initializer_statistics=true, then 1000 batches
stats_lineage.response: response_wm_v1 +0 copies lanes +1000; historical u1 RMS buffers and paired C20/T2 initial buffers frozen
